summary: Pakistani organizations should immediately prioritize patching critical vulnerabilities such as CVE-2026-20349 and CVE-2026-68820, which are being actively exploited and have been added to the CISA KEV catalog, affecting multiple vendors including Microsoft and Google. The top zero-day exploits, including CVE-2026-72898 and CVE-2026-8037, should also be addressed urgently to prevent potential attacks, and organizations should refer to the Pakistan CERT alerts PKCERT-71DA9F40 and PKCERT-E48A22A6 for specific guidance. To mitigate these threats, Pakistani organizations are advised to apply the latest security updates from vendors, implement robust security controls, and monitor their systems for any suspicious activity related to these vulnerabilities, particularly those affecting widely used software from vendors like Adobe and Cisco.
